Loading libraries
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
library(p8105.datasets)
  data("instacart")
```

Loading data
```{r}
instacart_df = 
  instacart |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  group_by(
    order_id,
    order_dow,
    order_hour_of_day,
    days_since_prior_order
  ) |> 
  summarize(
    n_products = n()
  ) |> 
  ungroup()
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart A: 
Does the number of days since the last order relate to the number of products purchased per order?

```{r}
scatter_df = 
  instacart_df |> 
  group_by(days_since_prior_order) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_products = mean(n_products)
  )
scatter_p = 
  scatter_df |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~days_since_prior_order,
    y = ~mean_products,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    alpha = 0.5
  )
```
